To maximize the total reward in a 3-armed bandit problem, one must balance exploration (trying arms with unknown or uncertain values) and exploitation (choosing the arm known to provide the highest reward).

Since "Highest Reward" has already yielded a positive mean (1.9) after one pull, and the other two arms have not been explored yet, I must explore the other options to ensure I am not missing an even better reward distribution, while keeping the exploitation of the "Highest Reward" arm as a fallback.
